title: Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories vs code review and technical debt stories on points
question: Does a story about Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code get more points than a story about code review and technical debt?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code gets more points than a story about code review and technical debt.
expect: If true, points per story for Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories should be at least 1.5x the value for code review and technical debt stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code against code review and technical debt

group_a.label: Git, Linux, Neovim, Nix and VS Code stories ({from} to {to})

group_b.label: Code review and technical debt stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h310 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h310 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
